ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Algae and floating plants are a ______ for minnows.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web, at the bottom there is the label "Algae and floating plants"; from it there is an arrow slanting upward to the " Minnows" label on the right, indicating that the energy/food of algae and floating plants is transferred to small fish. The diagram also shows the small fish then pointing to ducks, fish, and other organisms. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually point from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Algae and floating plants can make their own food and belong to producers. Therefore, for minnows, algae and floating plants are producer.
